Trump Explores Crypto Venture with UAE Backing

Former US President Donald Trump is reportedly exploring a deal to bring an obscure cryptocurrency platform to the United States. The venture involves a 49% stake backed by a UAE-based figure described as a 'spy sheikh'. Wall Street and financial observers are expected to closely monitor this development. The specific platform and the full extent of the UAE figure's involvement are not detailed.
